Visually, 8 out of 9 diagnostic checkpoints failed. The vehicle lacks the required dimensions, window configuration, door mechanism, and wheel structure of a minibus. The artifact score is low (poor quality) due to these structural collapses, comparable to or worse than the 'mid' reference image which had fewer structural failures.
